title: Paper boat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='paper' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#fdfdfa'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#e8e6dc'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='paper2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#dcdacf'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- water waves -->
  <path d='M4 78 Q14 72 24 78 Q34 84 44 78 Q54 72 64 78 Q74 84 84 78 Q92 74 96 78 L96 86 Q86 80 76 86 Q66 92 56 86 Q46 80 36 86 Q26 92 16 86 Q10 82 4 86 Z' fill='#3fb7e8'/>
  <path d='M4 84 Q14 78 24 84 Q34 90 44 84 Q54 78 64 84 Q74 90 84 84 Q92 80 96 84 L96 92 Q86 86 76 92 Q66 98 56 92 Q46 86 36 92 Q26 98 16 92 Q10 88 4 92 Z' fill='#2b8fc4'/>
  <!-- boat shadow on water -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='30' ry='5' fill='#1f6f9c' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- hull sides -->
  <path d='M14 60 L50 78 L50 78 L86 60 L78 76 Q50 84 22 76 Z' fill='#cfccbe'/>
  <!-- hull front strip -->
  <path d='M14 60 L50 78 L50 78 L86 60 L86 62 L50 80 L14 62 Z' fill='#f2f0e6'/>
  <!-- main triangular sail (front) -->
  <path d='M50 24 L50 74 L24 74 Z' fill='url(#paper)'/>
  <!-- sail shading edge -->
  <path d='M50 24 L50 74 L44 74 Z' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- back sail flap -->
  <path d='M50 32 L50 70 L74 70 Z' fill='url(#paper2)'/>
  <!-- sail crease highlight -->
  <path d='M50 26 L50 72 L52 72 L52 26 Z' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.45'/>
  <!-- hull upper rim highlight -->
  <path d='M14 60 L50 76 L86 60 L86 63 L50 79 L14 63 Z' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- small sparkle on hull -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='70' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='69' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
